title.narrative: Intensifying targeted HIV Prevention, Care and Treatment Strategies towards achieving the three 90’s targets

description.narrative: Ethiopia - HIV - Federal Ministry of Health of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia - FMOH. This program has the following goals: To attain HIV epidemic control nationally by 2025, by reducing new HIV infections and AIDS mortality to less than 1 per 10,000 population. The objectives of this program are: To reach 90% of Key and Priority populations with targeted combination HIV prevention interventions by 2025. To enhance HIV case finding to attain 95% of PLHIV knowing their HIV status and linked to care by 2025. To attain virtual elimination of MTCT of HIV and Syphilis by 2025. To enroll 95% of PLHIV who know their status into HIV care and treatment and attain viral suppression to at least 95% for those on antiretroviral treatment.. To mobilize resources and maximize efficiencies in allocation and utilization. To enhance generation and utilization of Strategic Information for an accelerated evidence based response
